# SlideButton

The three Swift source files and MIT license are from [no-comment/SlideButton v1.3.0](https://github.com/no-comment/SlideButton/tree/5eacebba4d7deeb693592bc9a62ab2d2181e133b).

The local manifest includes only the library target. It omits the upstream formatting dependency, which the library target does not use. The Swift sources are unchanged.
